targetText: Today there was spring in Vassilissa's heart also. It had almost frozen in the winter; always lonely, always alone.
explanation: Depicting the emotional hardship and personal sacrifices of Bolshevik activists during the civil war and economic recovery.

targetText: You'll see, we'll live like fine people. I have a horse and a cow of my own, and an automobile always at my disposal. I have servants, so that you will have no work to do in the house
explanation: Volodya's letter reveals his growing attraction to NEP-era privileges (servants, private cars), signaling his departure from revolutionary modesty.
